name: claude-usage
description: Lets Claude see how much of your 5-hour and weekly usage limits remain.
long_description:
Adds a get_claude_usage tool that reports the remaining percentage of your Claude plan's rolling 5-hour window and weekly window, with reset times, so Claude can pace long tasks and wrap up before hitting a limit.

The numbers come from the companion browser extension "Usage Bridge for Claude" (Chrome or Edge), which reads them from claude.ai with the browser's own sign-in and hands them to this extension over 127.0.0.1 only. No password, cookie or token is copied anywhere.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

tools.name: get_claude_usage
tools.description: Remaining percentage of the 5-hour and weekly usage limits, with reset times.

organization.title: Organization (optional)
organization.description: If your account belongs to several claude.ai organizations (for example a personal plan and a team), the name of the one to report. Leave empty to use the first one that has 5-hour/weekly limits.

port.title: Local port
port.description: Port on 127.0.0.1 where the browser extension delivers readings. Change it only if 47832 is used by something else, and set the same port in the browser extension.
